sarah: Quick follow-up on a tiny ingress idea: emit a compact admit hint header and an opt-in resume trailer for routes that support resumable outputs. Goal: give SDKs a non-disruptive signal and keep traces sampled.

alex: Compact sounds good. Perf question: atomic read cost at hot dispatch?

sarah: Atomic read only, no allocations unless sampled. Gate with `edge.admit_hints.enabled` and per-route visibility. Example: `X-Edge-Admit: lvl=2;q=37;w=5`.

jamie: How do clients treat lvl values?

sarah: lvl=0 healthy, 1 advisory, 2 constrained (backoff), 3 shed (reject non-priority). Document SDK defaults: ignore lvl=1, gentle backoff at lvl>=2.

mike: Streaming resume: trailer size, token form, and billing?

sarah: Trailer only when route enables resumable. `Edge-Resume: tok=base64url...;off=1536;exp=300`. Tokens include model-version digest, window id, HMAC. Billing: charge only for new tokens after resume; checkpoint metadata TTL=5m by default.

alex: Sampling & dashboards?

sarah: Metrics: aggregate queue histograms scraped 10s. Traces: sample at admit when lvl>=2 or resume emitted. Dashboards: "Ingress admit heatmap" + per-route trend. Alert if sustained lvl>=2 >60s.

ops-bot: RFC-1402 staged to canary at 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

jamie: Please include token spec (size cap 64 bytes) and feature flags in the RFC.

sarah: Will do, pushing a short spec now. Thanks. :thumbsup:
